environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (HTTP API type) with default stage, public endpoint enabled, no authorization configured. Lambda execution role has AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess and SecretsManagerReadWrite for report data retrieval. Function is in VPC subnet but API Gateway endpoint is publicly routable with no resource policy restrictions.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API, public endpoint, no authorizer
config.vpc: present but API GW endpoint is public
